tickets.goal: In octopus/resources.py, introduce one small private helper named _normalize_resource_key that performs exactly str(value).strip().lower(). Use it only for resource-key normalization in declarations(), get(), and declare(). Preserve every public API, error message, database query, ordering rule, state transition, and resource semantics. Do not modify tests or any other file.
acceptance_criteria: declarations(), get(), and declare() use the helper only where they previously normalized resource keys
all error messages and resource behavior remain unchanged
no new import or module-level side effect is introduced
the existing resource oracle passes with the same PASSED node set as the baseline
